records.purpose: Copy the number of named action members, including the FIRST, LAST and INVALID sentinels.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*count)(sco_plugin* self, uint32_t* out);`
Copy the number of named action members, including the FIRST, LAST and INVALID sentinels.
records.ownership: Caller owns outputs; metadata is copied, and no engine pointer is returned or retained.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; self must be live.
records.reentrancy: No engine calls or callbacks; read-only metadata lookup.
records.results: OK copied; BAD_ARG invalid self, null output or malformed input; WRONG_THREAD off the game thread; UNAVAILABLE after Stop; NOT_FOUND unknown id or name.
records.absent_capability: game.input.registry is ON while the static registry is published; this does not attest live dispatch.
records.cleanup: StopInput withdraws the service and rejects calls through a retained table.
limitations: Tail members above 186 are corroborated by a build-unresolved census; no live binding or input injection.
The 1267 named members include LAST and INVALID at the same numeric id.
C++/C#/Lua typed wrappers are unsupported for this addition; C function-table access is the supported surface.
